scope: Private virtual daemon; no ALSA, session manager, D-Bus, host discovery, hardware output or latency qualification

check.scope: Private virtual PipeWire graph only; no physical routing, latency or sustained qualification
check.startup_sample_scope: Receiver constant-sample validation and recorder attachment start only after ready and at least 1024 output frames. Startup fade samples are excluded; analytic ramp correctness is covered by core tests, not click-free qualification here. Receiver counters are never reset.

source_handoff.scope: Two bounded callback source handoffs on one private virtual graph; muted target, exact audible peer, master recording attached continuously. Startup fade excluded after at least 1024 output frames. Hardware and sustained qualification remain separate.
